captions.text: Sol 1: just the two landing pods
Month 1: the rover rolls off the cargo pod
Month 3: reactors for power day, night and in storms
Month 7: making oxygen and fuel from air and ice
Month 8: a greenhouse, linked by a sealed walkway
Month 12: a second habitat, linked in month 13
Month 14: soil walls block some radiation
Month 16: a big dish to talk to Earth
Month 21: the ascent vehicle's tanks keep filling
Month 26: the next launch window opens on Earth
